Definition: from G4253 and a derivative of G156; to accuse already, i.e. previously charge:--prove before.
BiblicalUsage: Proaitiaomai means to charge beforehand, to have already proved. Paul uses it once: we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the charge stands against all of us alike, and that is why the gospel has to be for all of us alike.
